rules.title: Cambridge Fair Housing Ordinance – source-of-income discrimination prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords and rental agents may not discriminate in renting or in the terms and conditions of tenancy based on source of income, including Section 8 and public benefits. They may use reasonable selection standards, such as ability to pay rent, only if those standards are applied equally and uniformly to all applicants.
rules.key_value: Source of income (including Section 8 and public benefits) is a protected category
rules.quoted_span: Source of Income, includes Section 8 and public benefits
rules.coverage_text: Real estate transactions in Cambridge, including viewing or renting an apartment and the terms and conditions of tenancy.
rules.exemptions: There is an exemption for 2-family dwellings when the owner lives there.
rules.penalty: After a hearing, the Commission may file a criminal complaint in District Court, levy civil fines of up to $300 for each violation, file a civil complaint in Superior Court seeking injunctive relief, and seek an award of damages, expenses and other relief. Either party may remove the case to Massachusetts Superior Court or to the Attorney General's Office.
